## Definition
The emergent, nonlinear temporal behavior arising from the complex connectivity and interactions within a random nanoparticle network, used as a computational resource. Exploits natural physical complexity for computation, reducing the need for precise fabrication and enabling robust, fault-tolerant neuromorphic systems.
